shortDescription: Shares of Indian IT services firm Coforge NSE:COFORGE fell more than 7% on Wednesday after Chairman Om Prakash Bhatt resigned following concerns raised by an internal audit over the company's board evaluation process.Shares were down 7.12% at 1,809.20 rupees, as of 9:16 am IST.

children: Shares of Indian IT services firm Coforge
fell more than 7% on Wednesday after Chairman Om Prakash Bhatt resigned following concerns raised by an internal audit over the company's board evaluation process.
Shares were down 7.12% at 1,809.20 rupees, as of 9:16 am IST.
